detailedDescription:
**Autonomous Driving Club 'S.D.S' (Self-Driving Shelter)**
*Advisor: Prof. Yong-Soo Choi*
As the founder and **Vision Team Leader** (Mar. 2022 - Feb. 2024), I spearheaded the development of the vision-based perception system for the **ERP-42 EV** autonomous platform during the [2023 University Creative Mobility Competition](https://youtu.be/vpsECdRKy98?si=V4lAiZT2x3ip3sKj). I was responsible for the end-to-end design and implementation of environment perception algorithms, specifically architecting robust **Object Detection** and **Lane Detection** logics. My key technical contributions included curating a custom dataset of **3,500 images** to train a YOLOv5-based traffic signal recognition system and engineering a lane-keeping algorithm optimized for dynamic obstacle avoidance.

### Technical Report Abstract
This report proposes a **rule-based** lane recognition algorithm for autonomous navigation that operates independently of deep learning frameworks, thereby eliminating the need for pre-trained data and heavy computational overhead. By **decoupling** the processing of orange and white lane markers, the system ensures operational stability even under significant **visual occlusion**. Engineered for complex obstacle avoidance and validated across extreme illumination shifts (e.g., tunnel transitions), the proposed method demonstrates superior real-time reliability on **resource-constrained** embedded platforms.
